_comment: Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Prompted Updates > Prompted Update Scenario 2 ('Forced CCZ update blocker screen'). NOT a single atomic pre-step - the two actions below must straddle an on-device login, so this file is run in TWO passes against flows/prompted_updates/scenario_02_forced_ccz_update.yaml (same 'run between the halves' pattern as hq_setup/recovery_measures/reinstall_update_app_flow.json): (1) run set_prompt_update_settings BEFORE the flow's first login (so that first login, against the still-In-Test latest build, shows no blocker); (2) after the flow's first login/assert checkpoint, run mark_build_status BEFORE the flow's relogin (marking latest Released is what actually triggers the forced 'New version of the application is required' blocker on that relogin). In practice: comment out / split the actions list per pass, or extend scripts/run_suite.py to pause here - see the flow file's own '=== HQ pre-step runs here ===' markers for exactly where each action belongs. ASSUMES the device has already been uninstalled and reinstalled to the prior released version (harness-level, out of hq_client.py's scope) and Setup 2/3 have already run. app_id/saved_app_id are placeholders - confirm current ids on the qateam domain before relying on this.
